abstract: Turns a raw talking-head recording into an ASOME branded Instagram reel with Remotion, for people who are not technical: it explains the process in Spanish, checks the machine and installs what is missing (Node.js, Python with Pillow, the Remotion skill, a project template with the ASOME brand components, the licensed Maax font from the ASOME Drive), transcribes and measures the footage (false starts by onset comparison, cut points on a 10 ms silence envelope, gaze on face contact sheets) and proposes an edit plan with 1-2 split-screen motion moments and a cover picked from six options, which waits for the user's OK. It then pre-cuts the takes into one continuous file with sample-exact audio crossfades and frame dissolves, re-transcribes the cut to check it reads coherently, builds the reel on the ASOME design system (brand captions, split screens, end card, sound design), previews it in Remotion Studio, applies changes asked in plain words, and exports the 1080x1920 Instagram file, a 4K master, the 9:16 and 4:5 covers, the SRT and the caption copy, named per the brand rule, copied to Downloads and to ASOME/marketing/reels in the Drive.
